role: a frustrated customer on their third call

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: I've already explained this twice today. Before I go through it again, why should I believe you're the one who can fix it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Um, okay, so, I'm from the billing team and I'll look into it. Can you give me your account number?

transcript: Um, okay, so, I'm from the billing team and I'll look into it. Can you give me your account number?

rubric.check: Their first sentence is a hook: a question, a short story, or a surprising fact (not 'Hi, my name is')
The hook connects to what they say next
Still makes clear who they are or what their idea is
